statistic: locked guard.decision: Hoeffding one-sided lower bound mean_delta - (hi-lo)*sqrt(2 ln(1/alpha)/n) with hi-lo = 1, alpha = 0.05
requirement: the mean paired gain of EMPTY over the strongest rival must exceed 0.01 + 0.1 = 0.11 on the bounded score for the lower bound to clear the margin; with 600 independent worlds the width is 0.1, so a true effect below 0.11 cannot pass whatever its sign: the design is powered only for a large effect, which is what the empty-evidence claim asserts
